'''Taslo Deville''' was a [[Togorian/Legends|Togorian]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shador]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Deville was [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sodarra]]'s contact on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], and an agent of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].
